dialects.description: Comma-separated target dialects this object belongs to. Omitted means every dialect; a target the scope excludes leaves the object out of its desired state entirely, so nothing compares or plans it there.

foreign_column.description: Single referenced column for FOREIGN KEY constraints.

foreign_columns.description: Comma-separated referenced columns for composite FOREIGN KEY constraints.

foreign_table.description: Referenced table for FOREIGN KEY constraints.

include.description: Comma-separated PostgreSQL INCLUDE columns for covering UNIQUE constraints.

ptah.schema.continuousaggregate.description: Declares a TimescaleDB continuous aggregate: a materialized view over a hypertable the extension keeps up to date.

materialized_only.description: Read only materialized data, rather than combining it with the rows since the last refresh.

name.description: Aggregate name, which is also the view name.

ptah.schema.data.description: Declares external reference/seed row data for a table.

file.description: Path to the YAML row-data file, relative to the Go source file.

key.description: Comma-separated key column(s) forming each row's identity.

schema.description: Database schema the table belongs to.

table.description: Target table the rows belong to.

ptah.schema.defaultprivilege.description: Declares privileges on a named role's future objects.

dialects.description: Comma-separated target dialects for this declaration.

grantable.description: Subset of privileges carrying WITH GRANT OPTION.

grantee.description: Role receiving privileges; PUBLIC selects every role.

object_type.description: TABLES, SEQUENCES, FUNCTIONS or TYPES; globally also SCHEMAS or LARGE OBJECTS.

privileges.description: Comma-separated granted privileges. Required unless revoked is set.

revoked.description: Comma-separated revoked privileges; ALL selects every privilege of the object class.

schema.description: Schema of the objects; omitted for global defaults.

dialects.description: Comma-separated target dialects this object belongs to. Omitted means every dialect; a target the scope excludes leaves the object out of its desired state entirely, so nothing compares or plans it there.

initially.description: Initial check timing: immediate or deferred.

requires.description: CSV list of exact required extension names.

table.description: Owning table; defaults to the struct's table.

ptah.schema.extendedproperty.description: Declares a SQL Server extended property on the database, a schema, a table, or a column.

column.description: Column the property is on. Requires table.

name.description: Property name. MS_Description is refused: it is the object comment, which Ptah already manages.

schema.description: Schema the property is on, or that owns the addressed table. Omit for a database-scoped property.

table.description: Table the property is on. Requires schema; omit for a schema-scoped property.

value.description: The value, written back as an N'' literal. An empty string is valid.

dialects.description: Comma-separated target dialects this object belongs to. Omitted means every dialect; a target the scope excludes leaves the object out of its desired state entirely, so nothing compares or plans it there.

if_not_exists.description: Adds IF NOT EXISTS where supported.

ptah.schema.field.description: Maps a Go struct field to a database column.

api_expose.description: Whether this column reaches an exported API contract: none, read, write or read-write. It declares a contract shape and is not access control.

api_name.description: Name this column carries in an exported API schema, when that differs from the column name.

api_type.description: Type the API export projects this column as, named in Ptah's own type vocabulary.

foreign.description: Foreign key reference in table(column) form.

generated_kind.description: Generated column kind, such as STORED or VIRTUAL.

graphql_name.description: Name this column carries in the GraphQL export only, overriding api_name there.

openapi_name.description: Name this column carries in the OpenAPI export only, overriding api_name there.

primary.description: Marks the column as part of the primary key.

proto_name.description: Name this column carries in the Protobuf export only, overriding api_name there. It is the wire identity, so changing it retires a field number.

unique_expr.description: Uniqueness over an expression. Not implemented: rendering refuses a column that declares it.

dialects.description: Comma-separated target dialects this object belongs to. Omitted means every dialect; a target the scope excludes leaves the object out of its desired state entirely, so nothing compares or plans it there.

language.description: Function language. Omitted means the target's own: plpgsql on PostgreSQL, SQL on MySQL, MariaDB and SQL Server, PL/SQL on Oracle.

leakproof.description: Marks the function LEAKPROOF, letting a filter using it be pushed past a security barrier.

parallel.description: Parallel level: SAFE, RESTRICTED or UNSAFE.

security.description: Security mode: DEFINER or INVOKER. Omitted means the target's own: INVOKER on PostgreSQL and SQL Server, DEFINER on MySQL, MariaDB and Oracle.

settings.description: Routine configuration settings, `name=value`, separated by `;`; pin `search_path` on a DEFINER routine.

strict.description: Marks the function STRICT: it returns NULL without running when any argument is NULL.

columns.description: Comma-separated columns of on_table the privileges are limited to, such as state,decided_at. PostgreSQL only.

dialects.description: Comma-separated target dialects this object belongs to. Omitted means every dialect; a target the scope excludes leaves the object out of its desired state entirely, so nothing compares or plans it there.

refresh.description: ClickHouse refresh schedule, as ClickHouse spells it: `every 1 hour`, `after 30 minute`, `every 1 day offset 2 hour`. Omitted leaves the view maintained by inserts into its source.

refresh_strategy.description: Retired: refused when the annotation is parsed, on every dialect. Ptah does not refresh materialized views: one is populated when it is created, a changed definition is reconciled as DROP and CREATE, and it goes stale only when its source data changes, which schema reconciliation cannot observe. Remove the attribute and refresh from your own scheduler.
refresh_strategy.x-ptah-retired: Ptah does not refresh materialized views: one is populated when it is created, a changed definition is reconciled as DROP and CREATE, and it goes stale only when its source data changes, which schema reconciliation cannot observe. Remove the attribute and refresh from your own scheduler

ptah.schema.rowpolicy.description: Declares a ClickHouse row policy: a filter on the rows of one table that the users and roles it names may read.

to.description: Users and roles the policy applies to: names, ALL, ALL EXCEPT names, or NONE. Omit it to apply the policy to nobody.

using.description: Filter condition. Omit it to admit every row to the users the policy names.
